lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The morning mist hangs heavy on the shore
I find my footing on the solid floor
The restless waves are singing to the land
I hold the quiet promise in my hand
[Chorus]
Follow the light where the water meets the sky
Lift up your heart and let the shadows fly
A steady path is carved in stone and grace
I find my home in this sacred space
[Verse]
The lighthouse stands against the rolling tide
With secrets that the ancient waters hide
The wind whispers a story old and true
A steady rhythm pulling me to you
[Chorus]
Follow the light where the water meets the sky
Lift up your heart and let the shadows fly
A steady path is carved in stone and grace
I find my home in this sacred space
[Bridge]
When the storm clouds gather in the night
The stars ignite with a burning, holy light
[Chorus]
Follow the light where the water meets the sky
Lift up your heart and let the shadows fly
A steady path is carved in stone and grace
I find my home in this sacred space
[Outro]
